verdict.rationale: Preventing customer data from being used to train AI models is a fair privacy question for a SaaS product with AI features like Linear Agent. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-use controls. The items cover the changelog, customer requests, the API, agents, and MCP, none of which address AI training on user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
